name: Rodeo Drive / Special Events / Holiday Program Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Rodeo Drive Committee/Special
  Events/Holiday Program Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, April 25, 2024
  9:00 AM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  April 25, 2024 / 9:00 AM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, Deputy City Manager
  Keith Sterling, Special Events Film Coordinator Patricia Betancourt

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Request from Netflix for approval to close Beverly Gardens Park in front of the Lily
  Pond and to use branded Netflix logos in order to host Beverly Hills Cop event on
  June 20, 2024:
  a. Presentation by Patricia Betancourt
  i. Netflix is requesting the park to be closed to the public for four hours to
  allow for setup and breakdown for the 1 hour & 45-minute event.
  ii. The event will set up bike racks along Santa Monica, N Canon, Park Way,
  and N Beverly to control crowds and for safety.
  iii. Netflix will provide private security in addition to BHPD to secure the
  Beverly Gardens event as well as the premier in the Wallace.
  iv. The event will be for invited guests and press only.
  v. Netflix is proposing to use 4’x7’ branded logos on each side of the Lily Pond
  as well as two screens, two speakers, and a stage with a podium located
  in front of the pond.
  vi. They are also proposing to temporarily modify the Beverly Hills sign at the
  Lily Pond to say Beverly Hills Cop Axel F
  vii. Netflix is also requesting to place a large interactive boombox to the left
  side of the Lily Pond after the event from the 21st to the 23rd.
  viii. For the premier at the Wallace, Netflix is proposing to close one lane on
  400 N Crescent to allow for valet drop off, as well as sidewalk closures on
  Crescent, S Santa Monica, and Canon on all sides of the Wallace.
  ix. Tour Bus companies will be notified in advance of the closure of the Lily
  Pond so that they can modify their routes accordingly.
  x. All expenses related to the event are the responsibility of Netflix and will be
  paid in full prior to the event.
 Highlights for April 25, 2024
Rodeo Drive Committee/Special Events/Holiday Program Committee

  b. Netflix will be conducting a full marketing/PR campaign for Beverly Hills Cop which
  will be similar to other high profile Netflix campaigns.
  c. The Boombox will have to pass all building and safety codes in addition to noise
  ordinances.
  d. The City is planning to work with Netflix to have all event employees parked on city
  property.
  e. The event is planned to have 500 attendants.
  f. The Boombox will be fully staffed for safety and maintenance issues.
  g. Mayor Friedman wants City traffic control to make sure that the tour buses will not
  cause traffic on Santa Monica next to the Lily Pond.
  h. Netflix is requesting that the park be closed from 3-7 PM
  i. Mayor Friedman is unsure about approving the Boombox due to the lack of detail
  about what it is going to specifically be. He is supportive of it for the event itself,
  but not for leaving it up for three days after.

  3) Future Agenda Items:
  a. None

  4) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: April 25, 2024 / 9:59 AM
